claims.statement: White is promoted from transitional mono status only through this source-intake bundle, claim ledger, raw profile, raw placement packet, and generated QA; identity-layer or runtime text alone is not evidence.
White seeks peace and reduced suffering by asking individuals to prioritize the group and coordinate around shared needs.
White's primary means are structure, law, morality, incentives, and institutions that restrain individual choice toward collective order.
White's thematic center includes community, honor, defense, cooperation, law, religion, government, military order, and charity; it treats selfishness and recklessness as chief threats.
White is allied with Blue through planning, systems, and rules and with Green through community and creature-centered interdependence; it opposes Black's self-interest and Red's reckless freedom.
White's strength is organized, distributed, group-effective structure; its weakness is rigidity, over-prescription, and poor adaptation to the unexpected or individual edge case.

White's mechanical texture includes rules-setting, taxing, protection, lifegain, small-creature/team play, exile or conditional creature answers, enchantment ties, and slow once-per-turn card draw as a modern Commander-aware adjustment.
